title: Introduce toggle for isUmpire in Force design UI

comments_data.body:
Hi @IanMayo , I added the toggle for `isUmpire` flag and change the relevant places. 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26705621/126868686-3f32a63b-1c1d-41cc-aa85-16743a5ed82f.png)
I also plan to remove the `UMPIRE_FORCE` const but it is used in some places and the purpose of using does not related to determining this force is umpire or not, like this one `/serge/packages/components/src/local/mapping/index.tsx`, code line 246.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26705621/126868718-227b90d8-261c-4275-a5c8-47043ba5580e.png)
So I decide to leave it 🤔

> So I decide to leave it 🤔

Yes - correct.  For all of the `mapping` components we can keep the existing logic.

> Hello @lebaphi could you fix the use of `.umpire` in these two places please?
> [630f1ca](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/commit/630f1ca41a1882e4827b1ea02dcf6bdebc8a5acc)

Fixed @IanMayo
It seems the build has failed, let me check this 🤔

issues.body:

[A summary of what you did in no more than one paragraph]

2. use the command `git checkout -b *branch-name*` to create a new branch 
3. Make the clean branched changes
